title: Two vertices of a 2-connected graph lie on a common cycle
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph whose vertex connectivity satisfies $\kappa(G) \ge 2$. Then for any two distinct vertices $u$ and $v$ of $G$ there is a cycle of $G$ whose support contains both $u$ and $v$.
replaced:
If $G$ is 2-connected, then any two vertices of $G$ lie on a
common cycle.
